name: polyethylene glycol 400 + tetrahydrozoline + zinc sulfate unspecified form
purpose: Active ingredients Purpose Polyethylene glycol 400 1% Lubricant Tetrahydrozoline HCl 0.05% Redness reliever Zinc sulfate 0.25% Astringent
uses: Uses for the temporary relief of discomfort and redness of the eye due to minor eye irritations relieves dryness of the eye for the temporary relief of burning and irritation due to exposure to wind or sun for protection against further irritation
otcwarn: Ask a doctor before use if you have narrow angle glaucoma. Stop use and ask a doctor if you feel eye pain changes in vision occur redness or irritation of the eye lasts condition worsens or lasts more than 72 hours

src.label: Visine Red Eye Total Comfort Multi-Symptom
